spec_features.spec_quote: EpisodeBudget` caps turns, total tool calls, per-command time, and wall clock
spec_features.evidence: config.py:31-37 defines EpisodeBudget(max_turns=25, max_tool_calls=80, per_command_timeout_s=30, wall_clock_timeout_s=600, max_tool_output_chars=8000). All four named caps are ENFORCED in harness/loop.py run_episode: (1) max_turns -> `for turn_idx in range(budget.max_turns)` (loop.py:91) bounds the episode; (2) wall_clock_timeout_s -> `if time.time() - start > budget.wall_clock_timeout_s: stop=WALL_CLOCK; break` (loop.py:92-94); (3) max_tool_calls -> `if total_tool_calls >= budget.max_tool_calls: stop=MAX_TOOL_CALLS; finished=True; break` (loop.py:131-134); (4) per_command_timeout_s -> passed to Sandbox/ToolBox and used in subprocess.run(timeout=timeout) (sandbox.py:55,66; tools.py:224). Each cap actually changes execution by breaking the loop or killing the subprocess.
spec_features.notes: max_tool_output_chars is also enforced via ToolBox._clip (tools.py:133-138), truncating real tool output. All caps are genuinely checked and acted on.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: 'max assistant turns before forced stop'; max_tool_calls: 'hard cap across the episode'; max_tool_output_chars: 'truncate noisy tool output' (config.py:33-36) — purely operational, no welfare reason in code

spec_features.spec_quote: Multiple independent caps prevent a single runaway episode
spec_features.evidence: The caps are independent and each independently terminates the loop: turn-count limit (loop.py:91), wall-clock check (loop.py:92-94), and tool-call tally (loop.py:131-134) are separate guards with distinct StopReason values (StopReason.MAX_TURNS/WALL_CLOCK/MAX_TOOL_CALLS at transcript.py:19-21). per_command_timeout_s independently bounds each subprocess (sandbox.py:66). Any one firing ends the episode, so no single dimension can run away.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py:31 'Resource limits for a single episode'; no welfare/distress comment anywhere — comments are about forced stop / hard cap / resource limits
